title: 面向大语言模型的词汇级提示压缩：免训练确定性流水线及跨十一类任务的帕累托实证分析
summary: 提出一种免训练、完全确定性的CPU词汇级提示压缩流水线，包含11种可切换变换（停用词删除、词性剪枝、词形还原、WordNet同义词缩短等）。在1242条英文提示、11类任务上评估15种配置，最激进配置平均减少40.3% token，BERTScore-F1为0.876；仅停用词配置减少29.6%，F1达0.913，并刻画了各任务的压缩-保真度帕累托前沿。
summary_en: Proposes a training-free, fully deterministic CPU-only lexical prompt compression pipeline with 11 toggleable transformations (stopword removal, POS pruning, lemmatization, WordNet synonym shortening, etc.). Evaluated 15 configurations on 1,242 English prompts across 11 task categories: the most aggressive achieves 40.3% mean token reduction at BERTScore-F1 0.876, while stopword-only achieves 29.6% at 0.913, characterizing the compression-fidelity Pareto frontier per task.
